Daily Quiz.question: ১) One of the four mentioned below is not a novelist of Victorian Age in English Literature. Who is he/she?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Charles Dickens, Emily Bronte and Thomas Hardy are Victorian novelist. Jane Austen is the Romantic Novelist.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Who wrote the book 'History of England'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
The book 'History of England' is written by Thomas Babington Macaulay.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Thomas Hardy was influenced by both in his novels and in his Poetry by Romanticism, especially by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Thomas Hardy was an English novelist and poet. He was influenced by both in his novels and in his Poetry by Romanticism, especially by William Wordsworth.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) The Romantic age began in-
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Wordsworth and Samuel Taylor Coleridge jointly published the Lyrical Ballads in 1798. The Romantic age began in 1798 with the publication of Lyrical Ballads.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who is the writer of 'Victorian Age'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Keats, William Blake, Charles Lamb, Jane Austen, Lord Byron, William Hazlitt, William Wordsworth, S. T. Coleridge, P. B. Shelley etc. are the poet of Romantic Age. Emily Bronte is the poet of Victorian Age.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Charles Dickens is not the novelist for one of the following-
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) A Tale of Two Cities
Daily Quiz.exp:
Charles Dickens is the greatest novelist in the Victorian Period. His famous novels are A Tale of Two Cities, Great Expectations, David Copperfield, Our Mutual Friend, Oliver Twist, The Christmas Carol, The Bleak House, The Old Curiosity Shop, The Pickwick Papers, Hard Times, The Mystery of Edwin Drood, Little Dorrit, The Battle of Life.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who is famous for Dramatic Monologue?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Robert Browning is a famous for Dramatic Monologue. His famous works are Dramatic Lyrics, Dramatist Personae, The Patriot, My Last Duchess, Andrea Del Sarto, The Pied Piper of Hamelin, The Ring and the Book, Rabbi Ben Ezra etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Who wrote 'Culture and Anarchy'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Matthew Arnold is a Melancholic/Elegiac poet. The Study of Poetry, Literature and Dogma, Culture and Anarchy, Essays in Criticism are his famous books. His famous Elegy: Thyrsis, Rughby Chapel, Heine's Grave. Dover Beach, Sohrab and Rustom, The Scholar Gypsy, Cromwell etc are his famous poems.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Who wrote the book 'The Idea of University'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
John Henry Cardinal Newman was a leader of 'Oxford Movement'. His famous books: The Idea of University, Loss and Gain.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Mary Ann Evans is the real name of-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Mary Ann Evans is the real name of George Eliot and Samuel Langhorne Clemens is the real name of Mark Twain.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Who wrote the play 'The Importance of Being Earnest'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Oscar Wilde was an Irish poet, novelist and dramatist. His famous books and plays are The Importance of Being Earnest, A woman of No Importance, An Ideal Husband, The Picture of Dorian Gray etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who translated into English from Persian, The Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Edward Fitzgerald was translated into English from Persian, The Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who wrote 'The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Samuel Langhorne Clemens is the real name of Mark Twain. The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and The Adventures of Tom Sawyer are his famous books.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Who wrote the book 'Utilitarianism'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Famous books of John Stuart Mill are On Liberty, Utilitarianism, The Subjection of Women.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Who wrote the novel 'Oliver Twist'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Charles Dickens is the greatest novelist in the Victorian Period. Oliver Twist, A Tale of Two Cities, Great Expectations, David Copperfield, Our Mutual Friend, The Christmas Carol, The Bleak House, The Old Curiosity Shop, The Pickwick Papers, Hard Times, The Mystery of Edwin Drood, Little Dorrit, The Battle of Life etc are the famous novel of Charles Dickens.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) 'The Return of the Native' is written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Thomas Hardy was an English novelist and poet. He was influenced by both in his novels and in his Poetry by Romanticism, especially by William Wordsworth.
The Return of the Native, The Mayor of Casterbridge, Tess of the d'Urbervilles, Far From the Madding Crowd, The Poor Man and The Lady, The Trumpet Major, Jude the Obscure, A Pair of Bluest Eyes, Under the Greenwood Tree etc are his famous novels.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Who wrote the poem 'The Patriot'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
The poem 'The Patriot' is written by Robert Browning. The novel Patriotism is written by Sir Walter Scott.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who wrote the poem 'Dover Beach'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Matthew Arnold is a Melancholic/Elegiac poet. Dover Beach, Sohrab and Rustom, The Scholar Gypsy, Cromwell etc are his famous poems.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Who wrote the Novel 'Jane Eyre'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Charlotte Bronte is a Victorian novelist. His famous novels are Jane Eyre, Shirley, The Professor, Villette etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Who wrote the novel 'Vanity Fair'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Makepeace Thackery was an Indian born British novelist. His famous novels: Vanity Fair, The Virginians: A Tale of the Last Century, Catherine: A Story, The Newcomes.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) 'A Tale of Two Cities' refers to-
Daily Quiz.exp:
'A Tale of Two Cities' is a novel written by Charles Dickens. It refers to two cities such as Paris and London.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) Who is the writer of 'Victorian Period'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
William Wordsworth, Samuel Taylor Coleridge, George Gordon Byron are the poet of the Romantic Period. John Stuart Mill is the poet of Victorian Period.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) Who wrote 'Under the Greenwood Tree'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Thomas Hardy was an English novelist and poet. Under the Greenwood Tree, The Return of the Native, The Mayor of Casterbridge, Tess of the d'Urbervilles, Far From the Madding Crowd, The Poor Man and The Lady, The Trumpet Major, Jude the Obscure, A Pair of Bluest Eyes etc are his famous novels.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) Who wrote the novel 'Wuthering Heights'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Emily Bronte was a poet, novelist and fiction writer of Victorian Age. She was mainly famous for her fiction. His famous novel is Wuthering Heights.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) Who is the writer of 'Romantic Period'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Edward Fitzgerald, Cardinal Newman, William Makepeace Thackery are the poet of Victorian Age. William Hazlitt is the poet of Romantic Age.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) Who wrote 'A woman of No Importance'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Oscar Wilde was an Irish poet, novelist and dramatist. His famous books and plays are A woman of No Importance, An Ideal Husband, The Importance of Being Earnest, The Picture of Dorian Gray etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) 'A Pair of Blue Eyes' is a novel written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Thomas Hardy was a Pessimistic Novelist. His famous novels are Tess of the d'Urbervilles, Far From the Madding Crowd, The Return of the Native, The Poor Man and The Lady, The Mayor of Casterbridge, Jude the Obscure, The Trumpet Major, A Pair of Blue Eyes, Under the Greenwood Tree.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) Charles Dickens is a great-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Charles Dickens is the greatest novelist in the Victorian Period. His famous novels are A Tale of Two Cities, Great Expectations, David Copperfield, Our Mutual Friend, Oliver Twist, The Christmas Carol, The Bleak House, The Old Curiosity Shop, The Pickwick Papers, Hard Times, The Mystery of Edwin Drood, Little Dorrit, The Battle of Life.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) Who wrote the book 'The Origin of Species'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Charles Robert Darwin was an English naturalist. His famous books are The Origin of Species, The Decent of Man and The Origin of Life and Earth.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) Who is the writer of famous book 'Das Capital'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Karl Marx is the father of Socialism and modern scientific communism. Das Capital, Communist Manifesto,The Holy Family are his famous books.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.
